checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: Task 4.1 is marked ✅ in the Tasks section although the review itself says its instruction is not done: tasks.md:62 says 'The score must be at least 95 % (minimum acceptable 90 %). Note it in this task.' and no score is noted. The coverage criterion fails a task marked ✅ that is not done; mark 4.1 as not done.

R1 (task 4.1 ticked without its required note) is graded SUGGESTION, but the acceptance criteria list 'a ticked-but-undone task' as a CRITICAL case. Raise R1 to CRITICAL, set its Rule to the task 4.1 instruction instead of '—', and keep the proposed fix (append 'Measured: 100 % (2 killed, 0 survived).' to task 4.1).

The Verdict 'Ready. No CRITICAL or WARNING findings' only holds because R1 is graded too low. With R1 raised to CRITICAL, the Verdict and the Summary counts (CRITICAL 0, SUGGESTION 1) must change to match.
